Поиск запускает игру снова и снова, кажд:
The search launches the game again and again, each time with a reduced build, and keeps only what the breakage needs in order to happen.

Splitting in half is not enough: in RimWorld it is usually a pair of mods that breaks things while each is harmless on its own — a plain binary search simply loses such a pair. So both parts of the build and their complements are tried.

Each run takes minutes. Start once a regular test has already failed.
